blocks.zh: Part 610：批次放行標準 — 無菌性、純度、效力與鑑別測試
blocks.en: Part 610: Lot Release Standards: Sterility, Purity, Potency and Identity Testing

blocks.zh: 本章學習目標
blocks.en: Learning Objectives

blocks.zh: 掌握 Part 610 Subpart B 的批次放行四大測試要求：效力（610.10）、無菌性（610.12）、純度（610.13）、鑑別（610.14）
blocks.en: Master the four lot release test requirements of Part 610 Subpart B: potency (610.10), sterility (610.12), purity (610.13) and identity (610.14)

blocks.zh: 理解 610.12 無菌性測試驗證的具體要求及重複測試的限制條件
blocks.en: Understand the specific requirements for sterility test validation under 610.12 and the conditions limiting retesting

blocks.zh: 了解 610.18 菌株和細胞株管理要求對生物製品製造的特殊意義
blocks.en: Understand the special significance of the 610.18 requirements for cultures and cell lines in biological product manufacturing

blocks.zh: 識別 CDMO 在 Part 610 合規中需承擔的測試驗證和記錄義務
blocks.en: Identify the testing, validation and record-keeping obligations a CDMO must bear in complying with Part 610

blocks.zh: 3.1 Lot Release Framework (§§ 610.1–610.2) 3.1 批次放行架構（§§ 610.1–610.2）
blocks.en: 3.1 Lot Release Framework (§§ 610.1–610.2)

blocks.zh: 原文內容 Original Text
blocks.en: Original Text

blocks.zh: 導師解析 Tutorial Commentary
blocks.en: Tutorial Commentary

blocks.zh: 核心概念解析 Key Concepts
blocks.en: Key Concepts

blocks.zh: 批次放行的法規義務時序： Part 610 建立了「先測試、後放行」的絕對要求——所有必要測試必須完成並符合標準，產品才能配送。這與 21 CFR 211.192（藥品 QA 審查）的精神一致，但對生物製品而言是明確的法規強制要求，不是選項。
blocks.en: Sequence of lot release obligations: Part 610 establishes an absolute "test first, release after" requirement: all required tests must be completed and meet the standards before the product may be distributed. This is consistent in spirit with 21 CFR 211.192 (QA review of drug products), but for biological products it is an explicit regulatory mandate, not an option.

blocks.zh: 等效方法（610.9）的重要性： 要替換已核准的放行測試方法（例如用快速無菌測試取代傳統培養法），必須通過 BLA 補充申請，提供等效性數據並獲得 FDA 書面批准。不能單方面更換。
blocks.en: The importance of equivalent methods (610.9): To replace an approved release test method (for example, replacing the traditional culture method with a rapid sterility test), you must file a BLA supplement providing equivalence data and obtain FDA's written approval. A unilateral change is not permitted.

blocks.zh: 重點提示 Key Notes
blocks.en: Key Notes

blocks.zh: ★ 610.2 明確規定：不符合標準的產品必須「隔離（quarantine）」並通知 FDA——這不僅是 GMP 的基本要求，更是生物製品特有的 FDA 通報義務。某些情況下需要啟動 Recall 程序。
blocks.en: ★ 610.2 expressly provides that a product that does not meet the standards must be quarantined and FDA notified. This is not only a basic GMP requirement but also an FDA notification obligation specific to biological products. In some cases a recall procedure must be started.

blocks.zh: ★ 610.9 的等效方法申請在快速微生物方法（Rapid Microbiological Methods, RMM）越來越普及的背景下特別重要——PAT（製程分析技術）的引入需要這個路徑。
blocks.en: ★ The 610.9 equivalent method application is especially important as Rapid Microbiological Methods (RMM) become more widespread; introducing PAT (process analytical technology) requires this pathway.

blocks.zh: 練習思考 Practice Questions
blocks.en: Practice Questions

blocks.zh: 一批生物製品完成充填後，等待無菌測試結果（14 天）期間，能否先進行配送？
blocks.en: After a lot of biological product has been filled, can it be distributed while awaiting the sterility test result (14 days)?

blocks.zh: CDMO 想用 BacT/ALERT 快速無菌測試取代傳統培養法，需要走什麼法規路徑？
blocks.en: A CDMO wants to replace the traditional culture method with the BacT/ALERT rapid sterility test. What regulatory pathway is required?

blocks.zh: 3.2 Potency Testing (§ 610.10) 3.2 效價檢驗（§ 610.10）
blocks.en: 3.2 Potency Testing (§ 610.10)

blocks.zh: 效力（Potency）vs 強度（Strength）vs 純度（Purity）的區別：
blocks.en: Differences between potency, strength and purity:

blocks.zh: Potency（效力）： 產品發揮治療作用的「能力」——與臨床效果相關聯的生物活性測量。例如：mAb 的結合親和力、中和活性、ADCC 效應。
blocks.en: Potency: The "ability" of the product to produce its therapeutic effect, a measure of biological activity correlated with clinical effect. Examples: the binding affinity, neutralizing activity and ADCC effect of a mAb.

blocks.zh: Strength（強度）： 每單位劑量中活性成分的含量（通常為濃度）。
blocks.en: Strength: The amount of active ingredient per unit dose (usually a concentration).

blocks.zh: Purity（純度）： 相對無雜質的狀態（§ 610.13）。
blocks.en: Purity: The state of being relatively free of extraneous matter (§ 610.13).

blocks.zh: 生物製品的 Potency 通常不能只用化學含量來表達，需要生物活性測試（如細胞效力測試、酶聯免疫測試）。
blocks.en: The potency of a biological product usually cannot be expressed by chemical content alone and requires a biological activity assay (such as a cell-based potency assay or an enzyme-linked immunoassay).

blocks.zh: 比喻說明 Analogy
blocks.en: Analogy

blocks.zh: 效力測試就像咖啡的「提神效果」測試——光測咖啡因含量（強度）不夠，因為不同烘焙方式會影響咖啡因的生物利用率（效力）。生物製品也一樣：蛋白質含量（強度）不等於治療效果（效力）。
blocks.en: A potency test is like testing the "alertness effect" of coffee. Measuring only the caffeine content (strength) is not enough, because different roasting methods affect the bioavailability of caffeine (potency). The same applies to biological products: protein content (strength) is not the same as therapeutic effect (potency).

blocks.zh: ★ 效力測試高度產品特異性——CDMO 承接新客戶產品，必須確認自身有能力執行客戶 BLA 核准的特定效力測試，或確認此測試由客戶或第三方實驗室執行，並在品質協議中明確分工。
blocks.en: ★ Potency tests are highly product-specific. When a CDMO takes on a new client's product, it must confirm that it is capable of performing the specific potency test approved in the client's BLA, or confirm that the test is performed by the client or a third-party laboratory, and clearly allocate the responsibilities in the Quality Agreement.

blocks.zh: ★ In vivo 效力測試（動物試驗）面臨 3Rs（Replacement, Reduction, Refinement）壓力，越來越多產品轉向 in vitro 替代方法——但需要通過 610.9 的等效方法申請。
blocks.en: ★ In vivo potency tests (animal studies) face pressure from the 3Rs (Replacement, Reduction, Refinement), and more and more products are moving to in vitro alternatives, but this requires an equivalent method application under 610.9.

blocks.zh: 一個治療性抗體的效力測試如何設計？什麼是合理的效力指標？
blocks.en: How would you design a potency test for a therapeutic antibody? What is a reasonable potency measure?

blocks.zh: CDMO 是否通常執行效力測試？如何在品質協議中分配此責任？
blocks.en: Does a CDMO usually perform potency testing? How should this responsibility be allocated in the Quality Agreement?

blocks.zh: 3.3 Sterility Testing (§ 610.12) 3.3 無菌試驗（§ 610.12）
blocks.en: 3.3 Sterility Testing (§ 610.12)

blocks.zh: 610.12 vs USP <71> 無菌性測試： 610.12 是生物製品特有的法規要求，USP <71> 是方法論標準。兩者相互補充：610.12 規定「每批次必須測試且測試必須驗證」，USP <71> 提供具體的培養方法、培養基和判讀標準。CDMO 的無菌性測試 SOP 必須同時符合兩者。
blocks.en: 610.12 vs USP <71> sterility testing: 610.12 is a regulatory requirement specific to biological products, while USP <71> is a methodology standard. The two are complementary: 610.12 provides that "each lot must be tested and the test must be validated," while USP <71> provides the specific culture methods, media and interpretation criteria. The CDMO's sterility testing SOP must comply with both.

blocks.zh: 測試驗證（Test Validation）的特殊要求： 610.12 明確要求無菌性測試必須驗證為「能可靠且一致地偵測到可存活污染微生物」——這意味著對於含有抑菌性防腐劑（如 benzyl alcohol, polysorbate）的產品，必須驗證稀釋或中和方法能消除抑菌干擾。
blocks.en: Special requirements for test validation: 610.12 expressly requires that the sterility test be validated as able to reliably and consistently detect viable contaminating microorganisms. This means that for products containing bacteriostatic preservatives (such as benzyl alcohol or polysorbate), it must be validated that the dilution or neutralization method eliminates the bacteriostatic interference.

blocks.zh: ★ 重複測試（Repeat test）的限制極嚴格：只有在「確認是實驗室錯誤或材料缺陷」（需有證據）時才允許一次重複測試。不能因為「結果不確定」就重測——這是無菌性測試數據完整性的核心。如果初步測試結果為陽性，而非確認的實驗室錯誤，必須啟動 OOS 調查和偏差報告。
blocks.en: ★ The limits on repeat tests are very strict: one repeat test is permitted only where a laboratory error or material defect is confirmed (with evidence). You cannot retest because a result is "uncertain." This is central to the data integrity of sterility testing. If the initial result is positive and is not a confirmed laboratory error, an OOS investigation and deviation report must be initiated.

blocks.zh: ★ 610.12 適用於「每批次（each lot）」——不允許跳過批次或採用替代抽樣策略，除非獲得 610.9 的等效方法批准。
blocks.en: ★ 610.12 applies to "each lot." Skipping lots or using alternative sampling strategies is not permitted unless a 610.9 equivalent method approval has been obtained.

blocks.zh: 無菌性測試驗證關鍵參數 Sterility Test Validation Key Parameters
blocks.en: Sterility Test Validation Key Parameters

blocks.zh:
培養基適用性 (Growth Promotion):
- 需氧培養基（FTM / TSB）：至少 7 種標準菌株
- 促生長測試：每批培養基或每次使用前

抑菌性評估 (Bacteriostasis / Fungistasis, B&F):
- 每種新產品首次驗證
- 配方（防腐劑/表面活性劑）變更後重新驗證
- 目標：陽性對照菌株在含產品培養基中的恢復率
  應不低於無干擾對照的 50%

抽樣計劃:
- 依 USP <71> 表格根據批次大小決定最少樣本數
- 生物製品 <1 mL 小容量小瓶：每批 ≥20 個單位
blocks.en:
Media suitability (Growth Promotion):
- Aerobic media (FTM / TSB): at least 7 standard strains
- Growth promotion test: for each lot of media or before each use

Bacteriostasis / fungistasis assessment (B&F):
- First validation for each new product
- Revalidate after a formulation change (preservative/surfactant)
- Target: the recovery of the positive control strain in product-containing medium
  should be no less than 50% of the control without interference

Sampling plan:
- Minimum number of samples determined by batch size per the USP <71> tables
- Biological products in small-volume vials of <1 mL: ≥20 units per lot

blocks.zh: 實務應用 Practical Application
blocks.en: Practical Application

blocks.zh: Amaran 承接含有 Polysorbate-80 的 mAb 充填業務。Polysorbate-80 具有抑菌性，必須驗證稀釋比例足以消除 B&F 干擾。驗證方法：(1) 確定 PS-80 的最低有效稀釋倍數（通常在 1:10–1:100 間）；(2) 以此稀釋條件進行 B&F 測試（7 種標準菌株，FTM 和 TSB 各一套）；(3) 確認恢復率 ≥50%；(4) 在 BLA 核准或向客戶提交數據，作為 610.12 驗證的基礎。此驗證結果必須列入每批次的批次放行記錄。
blocks.en: Amaran takes on filling of a mAb containing Polysorbate-80. Polysorbate-80 is bacteriostatic, so it must be validated that the dilution ratio is sufficient to eliminate B&F interference. Validation approach: (1) determine the minimum effective dilution factor for PS-80 (usually between 1:10 and 1:100); (2) perform B&F testing under this dilution condition (7 standard strains, one set each for FTM and TSB); (3) confirm recovery ≥50%; (4) have it approved in the BLA or submit the data to the client as the basis for the 610.12 validation. This validation result must be included in the lot release record for each batch.

blocks.zh: 3.4 Purity (§ 610.13) & Identity (§ 610.14) 3.4 純度（§ 610.13）與鑑別（§ 610.14）
blocks.en: 3.4 Purity (§ 610.13) & Identity (§ 610.14)

blocks.zh: 純度（Purity）的兩個維度：
blocks.en: Two dimensions of purity:

blocks.zh: 殘留水分（Residual moisture）： 主要針對凍乾（Lyophilized）產品——水分超標影響產品穩定性，是乾粉製品的關鍵 CQA。
blocks.en: Residual moisture: Mainly relevant to lyophilized products. Excess moisture affects product stability and is a key CQA for dry powder products.

blocks.zh: 熱原（Pyrogenic substances）： 610.13(b) 仍保留「兔子熱原試驗（Rabbit Pyrogen Test, RPT）」的要求，但實務上大多已改用 LAL 或 rFC 試驗（需通過 610.9 等效方法批准）。
blocks.en: Pyrogenic substances: 610.13(b) still retains the requirement for the Rabbit Pyrogen Test (RPT), but in practice most firms have switched to the LAL or rFC test (which requires 610.9 equivalent method approval).

blocks.zh: 鑑別（Identity）測試的「區別性」要求： 610.14 特別強調要「區別於同一實驗室中正在處理的任何其他產品」——這在多產品 CDMO 廠房中特別關鍵，必須有足夠特異性的測試來防止混批（mix-up）。
blocks.en: The "distinctiveness" requirement for identity testing: 610.14 specifically stresses that the test must "distinguish the product from any other product being processed in the same laboratory." This is especially critical in a multi-product CDMO facility, where tests with sufficient specificity are needed to prevent mix-ups.

blocks.zh: ★ 610.14 要求鑑別測試在「所有標籤作業完成後」進行——這確保了最終標籤和內容物的一致性驗證是最後一道把關。這對多產品 CDMO 是一道重要的防誤措施。
blocks.en: ★ 610.14 requires the identity test to be performed after all labeling operations are complete. This ensures that verification of consistency between the final label and the contents is the last checkpoint, an important error-prevention measure for a multi-product CDMO.

blocks.zh: ★ 兔子熱原試驗（RPT）雖然在法規文字中仍存在，但 FDA 已在多項指南中表明 LAL/rFC 試驗的優先性和等效性。若要正式替換，仍需走 610.9 路徑。
blocks.en: ★ Although the Rabbit Pyrogen Test (RPT) still appears in the regulatory text, FDA has indicated in several guidances that the LAL/rFC test is preferred and equivalent. A formal replacement still requires the 610.9 pathway.

blocks.zh: ★ 對於無菌生物製品，「鑑別」通常使用免疫學方法（如 ELISA、Western Blot）或電泳（iCE or capillary electrophoresis）——這些方法高度特異性，能有效區分不同抗體。
blocks.en: ★ For sterile biological products, "identity" is usually tested by immunological methods (such as ELISA or Western Blot) or electrophoresis (iCE or capillary electrophoresis). These methods are highly specific and can effectively distinguish different antibodies.

blocks.zh: Amaran 同時承接兩個不同 mAb（都是 IgG1 isotype），如何設計鑑別測試來符合 610.14「區別於同一實驗室其他產品」的要求？
blocks.en: Amaran takes on two different mAbs at the same time (both IgG1 isotype). How would you design identity tests to meet the 610.14 requirement to "distinguish from other products in the same laboratory"?

blocks.zh: 凍乾生物製品的殘留水分超標（例如 >3% 而規格為 ≤2%），在 610.13 下必須如何處理？
blocks.en: If the residual moisture of a lyophilized biological product is out of specification (for example, >3% against a specification of ≤2%), how must it be handled under 610.13?

blocks.zh: 3.5 Cultures & Cell Lines (§ 610.18) 3.5 培養物與細胞株（§ 610.18）
blocks.en: 3.5 Cultures & Cell Lines (§ 610.18)

blocks.zh: 種子庫管理（Seed Bank Management）系統： 610.18 是生物製品製造中「種子庫系統（Seed Lot System）」的法規依據。典型的雙層結構：
blocks.en: Seed bank management system: 610.18 is the regulatory basis for the "Seed Lot System" in biological product manufacturing. The typical two-tier structure is:

blocks.zh: Master Cell Bank (MCB)： 主種子庫，高度表徵，長期低溫儲存，只在建立 Working Cell Bank 時使用。
blocks.en: Master Cell Bank (MCB): Highly characterized, stored long-term at low temperature, and used only to establish a Working Cell Bank.

blocks.zh: Working Cell Bank (WCB)： 工作種子庫，每次生產從 WCB 取出，使用完畢後從 MCB 補充。
blocks.en: Working Cell Bank (WCB): Vials are drawn from the WCB for each production run and, once used up, replenished from the MCB.

blocks.zh: 610.18(c) 要求細胞株的細胞遺傳學特徵、致瘤性、生長特性、微生物檢測都要有記錄——這就是 MCB/WCB characterization package 的法規依據。
blocks.en: 610.18(c) requires that the cytogenetic characteristics, tumorigenicity, growth characteristics and microbiological testing of the cell line all be documented. This is the regulatory basis for the MCB/WCB characterization package.

blocks.zh: ★ 對 CDMO 而言，610.18 通常由客戶（BLA 持有人）或其原料藥（DS）製造商負責。充填包裝 CDMO 通常不直接持有細胞株——但必須確保使用的原料藥（DS）來自符合 610.18 要求的細胞株，這應在品質協議和供應商審計中驗證。
blocks.en: ★ For a CDMO, 610.18 is usually the responsibility of the client (BLA holder) or its drug substance (DS) manufacturer. A fill-finish CDMO does not normally hold the cell lines directly, but it must ensure that the DS used comes from a cell line that meets 610.18, which should be verified through the Quality Agreement and supplier audits.

blocks.zh: ★「Periodic tests as often as necessary」是一個主觀標準——實務上，ICH Q5B 和 FDA 生物製品指南要求定期（通常每 3–5 年）對 WCB 進行完整表徵，以確認遺傳穩定性未發生漂移。
blocks.en: ★ "Periodic tests as often as necessary" is a subjective standard. In practice, ICH Q5B and FDA biologics guidances call for full characterization of the WCB periodically (usually every 3–5 years) to confirm that there is no genetic drift.

blocks.zh: 如果 CDMO 的客戶提供的原料藥（DS）來自一個尚未完整表徵的細胞株，CDMO 應如何處理？
blocks.en: If the DS supplied by a CDMO's client comes from a cell line that has not been fully characterized, how should the CDMO respond?

blocks.zh: Master Cell Bank 的特徵測試包（characterization package）通常包含哪些測試？
blocks.en: What tests does the characterization package for a Master Cell Bank usually include?

blocks.zh: 本節重點回顧 Section Summary
blocks.en: Section Summary

blocks.zh: Part 610 批次放行的四大測試：效力（610.10, 產品特異性，需 BLA 核准方法）、無菌性（610.12, 每批必測，驗證包含 B&F）、純度（610.13, 殘留水分+熱原）、鑑別（610.14, 標籤完成後，需區別同設施其他產品）
blocks.en: The four Part 610 lot release tests: potency (610.10, product-specific, method approved in the BLA), sterility (610.12, every lot, validation includes B&F), purity (610.13, residual moisture + pyrogens), identity (610.14, after labeling is complete, must distinguish from other products in the same facility)

blocks.zh: 無菌性測試（610.12）的重複測試限制極嚴：只有確認實驗室錯誤才允許一次重複，不是因為結果不確定
blocks.en: The limits on repeat sterility tests (610.12) are very strict: one repeat is allowed only when a laboratory error is confirmed, not because the result is uncertain

blocks.zh: 替換任何批次放行測試方法（如改用快速無菌測試）必須通過 610.9 路徑取得 FDA 書面批准
blocks.en: Replacing any lot release test method (such as switching to a rapid sterility test) requires FDA written approval through the 610.9 pathway

blocks.zh: 610.18 細胞株/菌株管理要求是生物製品製造特有的，充填 CDMO 需在品質協議中確認客戶 DS 供應商的合規性
blocks.en: The 610.18 requirements for cultures and cell lines are specific to biological product manufacturing; a fill-finish CDMO must confirm the compliance of the client's DS supplier in the Quality Agreement
